title: Trust boundary map (.securable/boundaries.yaml)
description: Repo-resident map of the system's trust boundaries (FIASSE v1.1 S4.2, S4.3). Maintained like code; read by any harness so generation starts from the map instead of rediscovering it.

data.description: Data classes crossing this boundary (credentials, pii, payment, content, telemetry, ...).

authority.description: The server-side authority behind this boundary (session store, IdP, ownership table) — the source Isolated Integrity derives from.
